text: 2.86 Identity Cards for Importers /Exporters (a) To facilitate collection of Authorisation and other documents from DGFT Hqrs and RA, identity cards (valid for 3 years) may be issued to proprietor/ partners / directors and authorised employees (not more than three), of importers and exporters, upon online application (b) In case of limited companies, more than three identity cards can be allotted per company. In case of loss of an identity card, a duplicate card may be issued on the basis of an self-declaration. (c) Identity card would be issued electronically with QR code and a Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) for electronic verification.
